title: Onboarding learning loop: ran to plateau — SHIP with scope
summary:
The onboarding KB learning loop ran to plateau against the trustworthy no-repo harness (blind held-out probes). Robust metric kb_rate_project (cold-independent): r0 86% (6/7) → r1 90% (9/10, eval grown) → r2 plateau (stochastic dip to 80%); kb_earned ~70%. It CLIMBED then PLATEAUED in 2 rounds and stopped per protocol. What drove the lift: refined the learner's KEEP criterion from 'non-obvious' to 'non-recoverable WITHOUT the repo' (it had been rejecting load-bearing config defaults like ESCALATION_DEFAULTS as 'obvious from the line' — but a cold agent can't see the line) + added onboard-mine-config.js. The learner then blind-discovered the 5-trigger escalation set from daemon.js:65 and wrote a crisp note, closing the content gap AND the lexical-retrieval recall gap at once. OVERFITTING GUARD HELD: eval grown 7→10 (learner blind to all probes, reads only git/docs/structure/config miners), metric NEVER hit 100% (ingest-reversible stayed FAIL despite 6 notes retrieved — learner won't keep that convention on its own judgment; no probe-specific nudging), controls 100% + cold strictly in (0,1) every round. VERDICT: ship onboarding-KB for high-churn solo/internal repos where load-bearing knowledge (rationale, chosen defaults, gotchas-behind-reverts) lives in git history + code but NOT docs — where cold agents are weakest. Lift is real, modest, and provably non-gameable. Committed to loop branch @4dd2c2f; main untouched by the run; daemon live.</summary>
